name: Verified First
summary: Verified First publishes three packages at $29.99, $54.99 and $79.99 and says it has no long-term contracts, annual commitments or minimum screening requirements. Candidates get a text invitation to sign digital disclosure and authorization forms, and the vendor lists 49 applicant tracking systems.

facts.text: The Premium package adds employment verification and education verification to the criminal searches in the lower packages.
Candidates receive a text invitation and complete digital disclosure and authorization forms on a mobile device, with automatic reminders.
Built-in pre-adverse action tools handle the notice process when a report needs further review.
The ATS integrations page lists 49 entries tagged as applicant tracking systems, including Greenhouse, Lever, Workable and JazzHR.
The pricing page does not say whether the listed prices are per check, and it lists no add-on or pass-through fees.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Nationwide criminal search, national sex offender registry, Social Security address trace and global watch list. The page does not state the unit

plans.name: Essential
plans.notes: Adds unlimited county criminal search. The page does not state the unit

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Adds employment and education verification. The page does not state the unit

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom screening packages and discounted volume pricing

hiddenCosts: The pricing page lists no fees, taxes or add-on prices, so court and agency pass-through fees should be confirmed with sales.
